title: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – God
fullTitle: Soul Feast #76: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – God

promo.text: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

description: In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav extends the inquiry into non-physical communication to its ultimate source: Divine Intelligence. From witnessing the wisdom of Genesis with Linda Francis to receiving an out-of-the-blue phone call from Oprah, Gary reveals how every encounter and every heartbreak is an intentional message from the Universe – precisely tuned for the spiritual evolution of each Soul.
At the heart of this transmission is the inquiry Gary once posed to Genesis: What is God?

Not a commanding, demanding force – but realms upon realms of unconditional compassion and wisdom, always present. This reframing transforms prayer from a five-sensory plea for relief into a multisensory co-creation with Divine Intelligence.

The intentionality of the Universe is undeniable: every experience in the Earth School is a curriculum. From the $7,000 gift offered with total trust, to the profound loss that served as a gateway to his greatest gain, and the phone call that reached ten million Souls – each event is a transmission from Divine Intelligence designed to support your spiritual evolution and the creation of Authentic Power.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:00) — The Communication That Never Stopped: Gary revisits the non-physical communication he experienced when Linda Francis arrived in Mount Shasta – an intentional frequency that quietly shaped the next 27 years of his life.

(03:15) — Channeling Genesis Together: How Gary and Linda became fellow students of Genesis – and why the frightened part of the personality initially resisted the sessions until the truth was revealed through the recording.
(08:48) — The $7,000 Moment: A pivotal scene where Gary recognized, with multisensory clarity, that his alignment with Linda was more significant than any form of external power.
(14:00) — What Linda’s Soul Gave Him: How Linda’s Soul’s transition awakened an appreciation for dancing, music, and people – transforming a profound loss into the spiritual evolution of the heart.
(15:40) — Oprah and Divine Orchestration: From a cabin in the mountains to a phone call that reached 12 million Souls – a precisely tuned transmission from Divine Intelligence.
(16:51) — What Is God?: The Genesis inquiry that removed Gary’s resistance and redefines prayer as a conscious multisensory co-creation with Divine Intelligence.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge Think of a moment that seemed too perfectly arranged to be random – a loss that opened a door, a call that changed everything, a gift that arrived in the shape of grief. What if that wasn’t luck or coincidence? If everything in the Earth School is a communication from divine intelligence, what has yours been saying to you – and are you ready to hear it?
